verdict.rationale: Drata ships its own lightweight Drata Agent for Ubuntu, Windows and macOS. It reads system preferences to verify screensaver locking, password manager, antivirus and automatic updates. Community reports confirm that personnel without the agent show up as noncompliant in the Drata dashboard, which is per-employee tracking. However, disk encryption is never named in the evidence, and no MDM integration is documented beyond an experimental custom-connection device endpoint. Missing for 10: explicit disk-encryption check, documented MDM integrations, first-party docs on the per-employee device compliance view.

support.subject: As an IT admin, workstation compliance is tracked per employee — disk encryption, screen lock, password manager — via an agent or MDM integration
